shortDescription: A Senate defense bill would let contractors conduct military hacking operations with US government approval, according to Bloomberg.The measure would mark the first time Congress has explicitly authorized the private sector to carry out offensive cyber missions.

title: Senate Bill Would Let Contractors Run Military Hacking Ops
